mapper.select: select h.id, h.product_id, h.browse_time, p.name as productName, p.main_image, p.status as productStatus, mp.shop_name as merchantName, sku_agg.min_price as minPrice, sku_agg.total_stock as totalStock from user_browse_history h left join product p on h.product_id = p.id left join merchant_profile mp on p.merchant_id = mp.user_id left join ( select product_id, MIN(price) as min_price, SUM(stock) as total_stock from product_sku where deleted = 0 group by product_id ) sku_agg on p.id = sku_agg.product_id where h.user_id = #{userId} and p.deleted = 0 order by h.browse_time desc
